data_fields.name: splat shown on a kill
data_fields.donor_constant: the health that was left (min of damage and health)

data_fields.name: splat slots per tick
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 (single slot, overwritten by each later hit)

best_idea: Clamp each hit to the health left, apply it to one health number, and send the displayed splat with current and base health in the same per-tick update, so the client never has to guess the damage.
decision_why: The clamp and the single health number are the rule to keep, but the donor's one splat slot per tick loses earlier hits when several land in one tick, and a kill followed by a hit in the same tick overwrites the killing splat with 0; with MAX_ATTACKERS = 3 that is normal. Fix: a short per-tick list of splats, health applied for every hit. HUD drawing is not in this donor, so the client side must be designed for Frankendom.
acceptance: Three enemies hit the hero on the same tick for 4, 6 and 5 with 20 HP: the hero ends at 5 HP, the frame shows three splats (4, 6, 5), and a server test asserts the HP delta equals the sum of applied damage and the splat list equals the three applied amounts, each clipped to the health left.
